verdict.rationale: The EIN online assistant page publishes, before the applicant starts, all three constraints the story asks about. It lists an exact Eastern Time operating window by day of week (irs-supp-1), a limit of 1 EIN per responsible party per day (irs-supp-2), and a 15-minute inactivity timeout with no save and a restart requirement (irs-supp-3). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these limits are enforced as published, and evidence of equivalent up-front disclosure for other online flows (e.g., IRIS, Online Account mobile-friendly forms).
